newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu to meet Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu to meet Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan will meet at the Israel-Jordan border on Tuesday against the backdrop of a memorial for seven Israeli girls killed by a Jordanian soldier.

Israel's Government Press Office (GPO) said on Monday the two would hold diplomatic talks and speak at a memorial ceremony before Netanyahu visited the "Island of Peace", a border area where the seven schoolgirls were shot dead on March 13.
The girls' parents are to dedicate a "hill of flowers" and plant trees at the site on Tuesday, the GPO said in a statement.

Jordan's King Hussein paid a condolence call on the girls' families after the attack and expressed shame at the massacre which took place at a beauty spot on Jordanian soil leased to Israeli farmers under a 1994 peace deal.
